entries.prompt: Create a shopping cart module with add/remove and subtotals
entries.decision: Scaffold Cart with validation; float money kept for demo simplicity

entries.prompt: Add a configurable sales tax and make the grand total explicit
entries.decision: Tax lives on the cart as a percentage; get_total applies it once - tests added in the same change

rejected_alternatives.approach: Hardcode the tax rate as a module constant
rejected_alternatives.reason: Rates differ per store; a settable field keeps the module reusable

entries.prompt: Add a holiday discount: apply_discount(pct) should reduce the grand total
entries.decision: Store the discount on the cart and apply it inside get_total (bug: applied twice)

rejected_alternatives.approach: Return (subtotal, discount) and let the UI compute totals
rejected_alternatives.reason: Pushes arithmetic to every caller; totals become inconsistent across views

entries.prompt: Add a receipt formatter printing items and the grand total
entries.decision: Render from cart.items() plus get_total; no new cart state

rejected_alternatives.approach: Render the receipt as HTML directly
rejected_alternatives.reason: The demo is terminal-only; HTML invites injection issues

entries.prompt: Pin the double-discount bug with an xfail test so it cannot silently regress
entries.decision: xFail test documents the known bug tracked in L-0003

entries.prompt: New session in a new tool: read the capsule first, then add quantity rollups for receipts
entries.decision: Added total_items(); the capsule confirmed rejected approaches; the name-keyed dict stays

rejected_alternatives.approach: Track items as a list and scan per add
rejected_alternatives.reason: Name-keyed dict keeps merges O(1); list scanning resurfaces per line
